I am looking for an intern to work in our SonyAI lab in Barcelona on a project on language mediation in generative music. The project takes a critical perspective on text-to-music systems, examining the assumption that language can function as a meaningful interface for representing and conditioning musical generation.

The focus is philosophical rather than technical and the ideal candidate is a PhD or Master’s student with a background in linguistics, semiotics, HCI, or other relevant fields.

The internship is paid and can last 3 to 6 months.

If you are interested, please get in touch and/or apply following the link below (don't worry about the position title).
